description: This file defines the LogNode interface for a logging system in an Android project. It specifies a method for logging messages with different priorities, tags, optional Throwable objects, and allows chaining of log nodes.

classes.name: LogNode
classes.description: An interface for a logging system component that can output logs to one or more targets. It supports chaining of log nodes and provides a method to log messages with various levels of importance.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Method to output a log message with specified priority, tag, message, and optional exception. Intended to be implemented by classes conforming to LogNode to handle logging behavior.
